# Vendored compression utilities

These modules are copied from [Celophi's lom-decomp repository](https://github.com/celophi/lom-decomp), under its MIT license. They provide the FIELD overlay decompression and recompression used by RandLom's land-level randomizer.

The original license is included in this directory. The vendored files are kept in the application package so the feature is available in standalone builds as well as source runs.
